abilities.span: At the end of your turn, deal 1 damage to a random enemy.

decisions.question: Can 'a random enemy' be the enemy hero?
decisions.discriminating_case: empty enemy board at end of turn: the enemy hero takes 1

decisions.question: Are enemies left at 0 Health by an earlier end-of-turn effect excluded?
decisions.discriminating_case: two end-of-turn effects: the first leaves an enemy minion mortally wounded; Cannoneer never hits it

notes: Hand Cannon (CAP_103) says 'your Cannoneers FIRE!': another card triggers this ability by name. v0.1 abilities have no IDs, so such references are not expressible yet.
